Course / Programme: Agniveer Soldier General Duty (Army) and Navy MR entry
Eligibility: Army GD needs Class 10 with about 45 percent aggregate and 33 percent per subject; Navy MR needs Class 10; age roughly 17.5-21 per notification
Entrance Exam(s): Agniveer common entrance exam plus rally, physical and medical tests
Typical Exam Timing: Rally and exam notifications roughly twice a year; track official portals
AP-Specific Notes: AP candidates attend rallies under army recruiting offices such as Guntur, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati
Career Outcomes: Four years engaged service with Seva Nidhi corpus; up to 25 percent retained in the regular cadre; thereafter police, security and private careers
Notes: ITI and open-school candidates holding Class 10 can also apply

Eligibility: Pass SSC; minimum age 15 as on August 31 of admission year
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance
Typical Exam Timing: Applications June-September; exams in March
AP-Specific Notes: Recognised by COBSE and the Government of India for higher education and employment; study through accredited institutions with Sunday personal contact programmes
Career Outcomes: Degree via OAMDC, POLYCET and other 12th-based routes
Notes: Open-school 10+2 passers are not eligible for NEET UG under current NMC rules

Course / Programme: Diploma in Agriculture and allied diplomas (Seed Technology, Organic Farming)
Eligibility: Pass SSC with science; selection generally on SSC merit as per ANGRAU notification
Entrance Exam(s): No CET; ANGRAU diploma admission notification
Typical Exam Timing: Notification typically June-August; check angrau.ac.in
AP-Specific Notes: Offered at ANGRAU constituent and affiliated agricultural polytechnics across AP
Career Outcomes: Agriculture extension and agri-input sector jobs; lateral entry into B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture via AGRICET
Notes: AGRICET is restricted to ANGRAU diploma holders

Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July; BIEAP exams March-April
AP-Specific Notes: Gateway to medical and allied science admissions across AP
Career Outcomes: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, B.Sc Agriculture, nursing, pharmacy, allied health
Notes: Open-school 10+2 is not accepted for NEET, so medical aspirants should stay in the regular stream

Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Common stream in AP and Telangana junior colleges
Career Outcomes: B.Com, BBA, 5-year LLB, civil services preparation, banking
Notes: MEC and CEC both lead to commerce degrees; MEC keeps maths open for quantitative careers

Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Humanities stream in AP junior colleges
Career Outcomes: BA, law, journalism, teaching, APPSC and UPSC civil services
Notes: English-medium sections are preferable for competitive exams

Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Popular commerce-leaning stream in AP junior colleges
Career Outcomes: CA, CMA, CS, B.Com, BBA, economics and finance careers
Notes: Strong fit for students targeting professional accountancy

Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent from a recognised board
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission to junior colleges
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July after SSC results; BIEAP exams March-April
AP-Specific Notes: Standard gateway stream in BIEAP junior colleges; fee reimbursement via Jagananna Vidya Deevena for eligible students
Career Outcomes: B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Arch, statistics, NDA, CA and degree routes
Notes: MPC with computer science variants is offered by many colleges

Eligibility: Pass SSC
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; direct admission to vocational junior colleges
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Job-linked groups such as engineering technology, paramedical, agriculture and commerce under BIEAP
Career Outcomes: Technician-level employment; lateral entry into 2nd year polytechnic diploma via SBTET bridge course; degree via OAMDC
Notes: Students must pass the SBTET bridge course in maths, physics and chemistry for diploma lateral entry

Course / Programme: ITI Craftsmen Training (NCVT and SCVT trades)
Eligibility: Class 10 pass (some trades accept Class 8); minimum age 14
Entrance Exam(s): No exam; merit-based counselling on qualifying exam marks
Typical Exam Timing: Registration April-May with Phase 2 till mid-July; counselling June-July; session from August
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at iti.ap.gov.in; fee about Rs 250 general and Rs 150 reserved; popular trades Electrician, Fitter, Mechanic Diesel, COPA, Electronics Mechanic; NCVT certificates are valid across India
Career Outcomes: Trade apprenticeship under NAPS; RRB ALP and technician jobs; lateral entry into diploma 2nd year; self-employment
Notes: About 84 government and around 400 private ITIs operate in AP

Course / Programme: NIOS Senior Secondary (Class 12 through open schooling)
Eligibility: Pass Secondary or equivalent; no minimum percentage
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; continuous admission streams
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions in blocks through the year; public exams April-May and October-November
AP-Specific Notes: Nationwide study centres; suits students who cannot attend regular college
Career Outcomes: Degree courses, POLYCET, BBA and BCA and most 12th-based admissions (NEET excluded for open-school candidates)
Notes: On-demand examination facility available for some subjects

Course / Programme: Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering or Non-Engineering
Eligibility: Pass SSC or equivalent (CBSE, ICSE, NIOS, APOSS accepted) with mathematics
Entrance Exam(s): AP POLYCET conducted by SBTET AP
Typical Exam Timing: Applications March-April; exam around end April or early May (2025: April 30); web counselling June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at polycetap.nic.in; fee Rs 400 for OC-BC and Rs 100 for SC-ST; 120 questions from Class 10 maths, physics and chemistry with no negative marking; tuition about Rs 4,700 per year in government and aided polytechnics and about Rs 25,000 in private; certificate verification at help line centres, special categories at Government Polytechnic Vijayawada
Career Outcomes: AP ECET lateral entry to B.Tech; junior engineer jobs; AMIE; PSU technician posts
Notes: Covers government, aided, private polytechnics and second-shift diploma sections in engineering colleges

Eligibility: Varies by job role; many courses need Class 8 or Class 10
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance; enrol at accredited training centres
Typical Exam Timing: Rolling batches through the year
AP-Specific Notes: Register at pmkvyofficial.org with Aadhaar; NSQF-aligned training, assessment and certification
Career Outcomes: Retail, logistics, IT-ITeS, healthcare, beauty, construction and other entry roles; also self-employment
Notes: Useful add-on alongside Intermediate or after Class 10

Course / Programme: Six-Year Integrated B.Tech at RGUKT (2-year PUC plus 4-year B.Tech)
Eligibility: Passed SSC of the admission year in first attempt (advanced supplementary candidates also considered); studied in AP; age not above 18 (21 for SC-ST)
Entrance Exam(s): No CET; selection on SSC marks with a 4 percent deprivation score added for government school students
Typical Exam Timing: Notification April-May; online applications in May; selection list June; classes from August
AP-Specific Notes: Fully residential campuses at Nuzvid, Srikakulam (Etcherla), Ongole and RK Valley (Idupulapaya) with about 1,000-1,100 seats each plus EWS supernumerary; apply at rgukt.in or AP Online and MeeSeva centres; free tuition for fee-reimbursement eligible students; exit option after the 2-year PUC
Career Outcomes: B.Tech in CSE, ECE, EEE, Civil, Mechanical, Chemical or Metallurgy with campus placements and MS or M.Tech routes
Notes: The flagship AP route for rural merit students; no campus transfers are allowed after allotment

Eligibility: Intermediate or equivalent with 45 percent aggregate (42 percent BC, 40 percent SC-ST)
Entrance Exam(s): AP LAWCET (5-year paper) conducted by Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam for APSCHE; CLAT for national law universities
Typical Exam Timing: LAWCET applications March-April with exam around May; CLAT applications August-November with exam in December
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/LAWCET; qualifying score is 35 percent (42 of 120 marks); exam offered in English and Telugu
Career Outcomes: Advocate, judicial services, corporate legal, litigation and advisory
Notes: Single-sitting or open-school qualifying backgrounds are not eligible

Eligibility: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics plus Chemistry, Biology or a vocational subject with at least 45 percent aggregate (40 percent reserved); 10+3 diploma with mathematics also accepted
Entrance Exam(s): NATA conducted by the Council of Architecture; JEE Main Paper 2 by NTA
Typical Exam Timing: NATA sessions on designated Saturdays across the admission cycle; JEE Main sessions January and April
AP-Specific Notes: School of Planning and Architecture Vijayawada and COA-recognised colleges such as Andhra University admit via these scores
Career Outcomes: Architect after COA registration, M.Arch, urban design, practice or public sector posts
Notes: Admission requires a valid aptitude test score plus the minimum academic eligibility

Eligibility: Pass 10+2 in any stream; upper age below 24 on August 1 with 5-year relaxation for SC-ST-PwD
Entrance Exam(s): NIFT entrance (GAT plus CAT and Situation Test) through NTA; UCEED by IIT Bombay for IIT design seats
Typical Exam Timing: NIFT applications November to early January with exam around February 9; UCEED applications September-November with exam mid-January
AP-Specific Notes: No NIFT campus in AP; nearest is NIFT Hyderabad; IIT Hyderabad offers B.Des via UCEED
Career Outcomes: Fashion, product, communication and UX design careers; M.Des
Notes: UCEED also opens design seats at several other participating institutes

Eligibility: Intermediate with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology
Entrance Exam(s): AP EAPCET (Agriculture and Pharmacy stream)
Typical Exam Timing: EAPCET applications March-April; pharmacy paper in May (2025: May 19-20)
AP-Specific Notes: Counselling through APSCHE; AP has a strong base of pharmacy colleges
Career Outcomes: Community or hospital pharmacist, drug inspector, pharma industry, M.Pharm via GPAT
Notes: Pharm.D is a parallel 6-year option through the same exam

Eligibility: Intermediate BiPC for agriculture; MPC students can enter B.Tech Agricultural Engineering and Food Technology
Entrance Exam(s): AP EAPCET (Agriculture stream) with counselling by ANGRAU
Typical Exam Timing: EAPCET in May; ANGRAU counselling registration July-September
AP-Specific Notes: 40 percent farmers quota with Form-I land certificate and Form-II rural study certificate; colleges include Agricultural College Bapatla, SV Agricultural College Tirupati and Agricultural College Mahanandi
Career Outcomes: Agriculture officer, bank field officer, agri-business, ICAR JRF, state agriculture department jobs
Notes: Agriculture diploma holders enter via AGRICET lateral entry

Eligibility: 10+2 with English as a subject
Entrance Exam(s): NCHM JEE conducted by NTA for NCHM and CT institutes
Typical Exam Timing: Applications December-February; exam late April (2025: April 27)
AP-Specific Notes: IHM Tirupati is the government institute in AP; IHM Hyderabad is nearby; many private colleges accept NCHM JEE scores
Career Outcomes: Hotel operations, airlines and cruise lines, catering, MBA in hospitality, entrepreneurship
Notes: The degree is offered by NCHM affiliated institutes

Eligibility: Intermediate BiPC with English; 45 percent in science subjects for OC and 40 percent for BC-SC-ST; age 17 by December 31; medically fit
Entrance Exam(s): APNCET conducted by Dr NTR UHS (from 2025; earlier via AP EAPCET BiPC ranks)
Typical Exam Timing: APNCET applications May-July with the exam around June-July; counselling August-September
AP-Specific Notes: Apply via drntr.uhsap.in; government nursing college seats and category-A seats in private colleges under Dr NTR UHS; both men and women are eligible
Career Outcomes: Staff nurse in India and abroad, NCLEX and OET routes, M.Sc Nursing, nurse educator
Notes: Allied health courses such as BPT are also admitted by Dr NTR UHS on Intermediate science merit

Eligibility: Pass Intermediate MPC or equivalent with PCM; aggregate norms vary by institution
Entrance Exam(s): AP EAPCET (Engineering) conducted by JNTUK for APSCHE; JEE Main by NTA for NITs, IIITs and CFTIs
Typical Exam Timing: EAPCET applications March-April with exam in May (2025: May 21-27); JEE Main sessions January and April
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET; counselling through APSCHE web options; colleges include Andhra University College of Engineering Visakhapatnam, JNTUK Kakinada, SVUCE Tirupati, JNTUA Anantapur and hundreds of private colleges
Career Outcomes: Software, core engineering, GATE and M.Tech, civil services, campus placements
Notes: EAPCET rank is also used for B.Tech seats in AP private universities

Eligibility: Intermediate BiPC with PCB and NEET qualification
Entrance Exam(s): NEET UG conducted by NTA
Typical Exam Timing: Same NEET schedule; AYUSH counselling follows
AP-Specific Notes: AP AYUSH UG admissions through Dr NTR UHS affiliated government and private ayurvedic colleges
Career Outcomes: Ayurvedic physician, MD Ayurveda via AIAPGET, own practice
Notes: BHMS (Homoeopathy) follows the same route

Eligibility: Intermediate BiPC with PCB percentage norms as per NEET
Entrance Exam(s): NEET UG conducted by NTA
Typical Exam Timing: Same NEET schedule; AP counselling by Dr NTR UHS
AP-Specific Notes: Government and private dental colleges in AP are affiliated to Dr NTR UHS
Career Outcomes: Dental surgeon, MDS, own clinic, government dental posts
Notes: BDS seats are filled through the same state counselling process

Duration: About 4 months study period before each exam window
Eligibility: Register after Class 10; eligible to appear after appearing in the Class 12 examination; graduates get direct entry to Intermediate
Entrance Exam(s): CA Foundation examination by ICAI
Typical Exam Timing: Exams thrice a year in January, May and September; register four months ahead (for example by May 1 for the September exam)
AP-Specific Notes: Register on the ICAI Self Service Portal; can be pursued alongside B.Com through AP colleges or self-study
Career Outcomes: Chartered Accountant after Intermediate, articleship and Final; audit, tax and finance careers
Notes: Passing needs 40 percent per paper and 50 percent aggregate

Course / Programme: General UG degree (B.A, B.Sc, B.Com with honours such as Statistics and Commerce, BBA, BCA, B.Voc, BFA, 5-year integrated PG)
Domain / Field: Arts, Science, Commerce, Computing and Management
Eligibility: Pass Intermediate from BIEAP or a recognised board; subject norms per course
Entrance Exam(s): No CET; OAMDC web counselling on Intermediate merit
Typical Exam Timing: Registration typically July-September after results; phases through September-October (2025 registration opened August 20)
AP-Specific Notes: Register at oamdc-apsche.aptonline.in; convener quota seats across government and private degree colleges; engineering and pharmacy excluded; DOST is the parallel portal in Telangana
Career Outcomes: Banking, SSC and APPSC exams, IT and BPO, teaching after B.Ed, CA or M.Com, M.Sc and research
Notes: Honours and integrated PG options are listed in the OAMDC course-college combination list

Eligibility: Intermediate BiPC with about 50 percent in PCB (40 percent for reserved categories); age 17 by December 31
Entrance Exam(s): NEET UG conducted by NTA (mandatory for all medical colleges including AIIMS and JIPMER)
Typical Exam Timing: NEET applications February-March; exam usually the first Sunday of May; AP counselling by Dr NTR UHS July-September
AP-Specific Notes: 85 percent state quota counselled by Dr NTR UHS through its UG admissions portal; key colleges include Andhra Medical College Visakhapatnam, SV Medical College Tirupati, Guntur Medical College and Kurnool Medical College
Career Outcomes: Doctor, then MD or MS via NEET PG, UPSC CMS, or practice
Notes: The 15 percent All India quota and central institutes are also filled via NEET counselling

Course / Programme: National Defence Academy (Army, Navy and Air Force wings)
Duration: 3 years NDA training plus pre-commission training
Eligibility: 12th pass; Army wing accepts any group, Air Force and Navy need PCM; unmarried; age 16.5-19.5
Entrance Exam(s): NDA and NA examination by UPSC plus SSB interview and medicals
Typical Exam Timing: NDA I notification December with exam in April; NDA II notification May with exam in September
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at upsconline.nic.in; women candidates are eligible; 11th class students cannot apply
Career Outcomes: Commissioned officer in the armed forces with a university degree earned during training
Notes: Air Force and Naval Academy candidates can also try the 10+2 cadet entry scheme

Eligibility: Intermediate with PCM or PCB
Entrance Exam(s): AP EAPCET (Pharmacy stream)
Typical Exam Timing: Same as the EAPCET pharmacy schedule
AP-Specific Notes: Offered by pharmacy colleges in AP under APSCHE counselling
Career Outcomes: Clinical and hospital pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, NAPLEX for the USA
Notes: Programme is regulated by the Pharmacy Council of India

Eligibility: Matric plus ITI in a relevant trade as per the division notification
Entrance Exam(s): Merit on ITI marks by the Railway Recruitment Cell
Typical Exam Timing: Notifications released periodically by divisions; watch the zonal RRC pages
AP-Specific Notes: South Central Railway and neighbouring zones notify Act Apprentice intakes with trade-wise vacancies
Career Outcomes: Apprentice certificate plus stipend; strengthens later railway recruitment prospects
Notes: Ex-Act Apprentices receive consideration in some railway recruitments

Course / Programme: Advanced skill modules at Advanced Training Institutes (AVTS) and PMKVY upskilling
Eligibility: ITI or NTC holders
Entrance Exam(s): Direct enrolment at the training institute
Typical Exam Timing: Batches run through the year as per institute calendars
AP-Specific Notes: DGT-run ATIs offer CNC, industrial automation and mechatronics type modules; check dgt.gov.in for institute lists
Career Outcomes: CNC operator, automation technician, quality inspector
Notes: Short modules stack well with work experience

Course / Programme: Agniveer Soldier General Duty (Army) and Navy MR
Eligibility: Army GD needs Class 10 with about 45 percent aggregate and 33 percent per subject; Navy MR needs Class 10; age roughly 17.5-21
Entrance Exam(s): Agniveer common entrance exam plus rally, physical and medical tests
Typical Exam Timing: Notifications roughly twice a year
AP-Specific Notes: AP rallies run under army recruiting offices such as Guntur, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati
Career Outcomes: Four years service with Seva Nidhi; up to 25 percent retention; then security and private sector roles
Notes: Technical sailor entries may ask for higher qualifications

Course / Programme: Assistant Loco Pilot and Technician recruitment in Railways
Eligibility: Matric plus ITI in a relevant trade (or diploma in engineering)
Entrance Exam(s): RRB computer-based tests plus aptitude test for ALP
Typical Exam Timing: Notifications periodic, not fixed annually; track rrbcdg.gov.in
AP-Specific Notes: Centralised recruitment through Railway Recruitment Boards with trade-wise mapping
Career Outcomes: Loco pilot or technician career in Indian Railways
Notes: Railway medical fitness standards apply

Eligibility: NTC or NAC in the relevant trade (diploma and degree holders also eligible)
Entrance Exam(s): Centralised CITS admission through DGT
Typical Exam Timing: Admission windows roughly May-August per DGT notification
AP-Specific Notes: National Craft Instructor Training Certificate is the credential sought for ITI instructor recruitment
Career Outcomes: ITI instructor, vocational trainer in industry and CSR programmes
Notes: Instructor posts also consider diploma and degree holders

Eligibility: ITI with NCVT certificate
Entrance Exam(s): Interviews and trade tests by employers
Typical Exam Timing: ITI placement drives cluster around course completion
AP-Specific Notes: ITI placement cells, district employment exchanges and the Skill India Digital hub list vacancies
Career Outcomes: Technician, electrician, fitter, welder and service technician roles; supervisor level with experience
Notes: Combining work with NAPS apprenticeship improves pay bands

Course / Programme: Lateral Entry into 2nd year Polytechnic Diploma
Eligibility: ITI pass with 60 percent in the relevant trade plus the SBTET bridge course in maths, physics and chemistry
Entrance Exam(s): No separate CET; admission via DTE and SBTET AP lateral entry notification
Typical Exam Timing: Notifications around May-June subject to vacancies
AP-Specific Notes: Limited to 10 percent of sanctioned intake; apply via SBTET and DTE AP portals; ITI holders may otherwise appear for AP POLYCET for 1st-year entry
Career Outcomes: Diploma, then AP ECET lateral B.Tech, junior engineer roles
Notes: Intermediate Vocational Course students with the bridge course share this route

Course / Programme: PM Vishwakarma training and self-employment support
Duration: Basic and advanced training of a few weeks
Eligibility: Age 18 or above and working in one of the notified trades
Entrance Exam(s): Enrolment through the portal with verification
Typical Exam Timing: Enrolment cycles through the year
AP-Specific Notes: Gives a training certificate, toolkit e-voucher of up to about Rs 15,000 and collateral-free loans up to Rs 3 lakh in stages
Career Outcomes: Own workshop or enterprise in trades such as carpentry, tailoring, blacksmithy and barbering
Notes: Complements ITI skills with business support

Eligibility: Pass Secondary or equivalent
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance
Typical Exam Timing: Admissions in blocks; exams April-May and October-November
AP-Specific Notes: Opens 12th-based eligibility while working
Career Outcomes: Degree, POLYCET, defence and most entrance routes (NEET excluded for open-school candidates)
Notes: Class 12 equivalency also improves promotion prospects in private jobs

Course / Programme: Specialised or additional ITI trade (Instrument Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker and similar)
Eligibility: Pass SSC; prior ITI preferred for advanced modules
Entrance Exam(s): AP ITI merit-based admission
Typical Exam Timing: Registration April-July; counselling June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Same iti.ap.gov.in admission process; NCVT trades give national mobility
Career Outcomes: Higher-value technician roles and better apprenticeship eligibility
Notes: Choose trades aligned to local industry demand

Eligibility: ITI or NTC in the relevant trade
Entrance Exam(s): No exam; register and apply to establishments on the portal
Typical Exam Timing: Rolling; establishments post opportunities through the year
AP-Specific Notes: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; government reimburses 25 percent of the stipend up to Rs 1,500 per month; completion earns the National Apprenticeship Certificate which counts as work experience
Career Outcomes: Absorption by the same establishment, PSU and government apprentice quotas, full-time technician roles
Notes: Railway zones and PSUs run large apprenticeship intakes under this framework

Course / Programme: AMIE (Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers) via Section A and B
Eligibility: Three-year engineering diploma holders join as Senior Technician members of IEI
Entrance Exam(s): Section A and Section B examinations of IEI
Typical Exam Timing: Membership enrolment any time; exams in summer and winter terms
AP-Specific Notes: Government of India notifies passing Sections A and B as equivalent to B.E. or B.Tech; accepted by UPSC, IITs and employers
Career Outcomes: Degree-level posts, M.Tech eligibility, promotion to executive engineer
Notes: Work-as-you-study route popular with employed diploma engineers

Eligibility: Polytechnic diploma is treated as Intermediate (+2) with 45 percent (42 BC, 40 SC-ST); ITI is not accepted
Entrance Exam(s): AP LAWCET (5-year paper) by Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam for APSCHE
Typical Exam Timing: Applications March-April; exam around May
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/LAWCET; qualifying 35 percent in the test
Career Outcomes: Advocacy, judicial services, corporate law
Notes: Diploma is the accepted non-intermediate route

Eligibility: 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics with at least 45 percent aggregate (40 percent reserved)
Entrance Exam(s): NATA conducted by the Council of Architecture (JEE Main Paper 2 also possible)
Typical Exam Timing: NATA sessions across the admission cycle; counselling rounds follow
AP-Specific Notes: SPA Vijayawada and COA-recognised colleges admit diploma holders with NATA scores
Career Outcomes: Architect, M.Arch, urban planning careers
Notes: Diploma holders must have studied mathematics

Course / Programme: B.Des through NIFT Lateral Entry Admission (NLEA)
Eligibility: Three or four-year diploma recognised by AICTE or a state board of technical education in fields related to fashion, apparel, textiles, design, visual communication and similar areas
Entrance Exam(s): NIFT entrance GAT plus technical ability test and personal interview on the NLEA channel
Typical Exam Timing: Applications November-January; tests around February with the main NIFT exam
AP-Specific Notes: Lateral entry into a later year of B.Des; apply through the NTA-NIFT portal
Career Outcomes: Design roles in the fashion and lifestyle industry
Notes: The diploma stream must relate to the design fields listed in the NIFT guidelines

Course / Programme: B.Pharm via lateral entry into 2nd year
Eligibility: D.Pharm from a PCI-approved institution
Entrance Exam(s): AP ECET (pharmacy paper)
Typical Exam Timing: Same ECET window in May
AP-Specific Notes: Admission into the 2nd year of B.Pharm under APSCHE counselling
Career Outcomes: Pharmacist, drug inspector, M.Pharm and industry roles
Notes: Open to D.Pharm holders specifically

Course / Programme: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture lateral entry via AGRICET
Eligibility: Two-year ANGRAU diploma in Agriculture, Seed Technology or Organic Farming; final-year students may also apply
Entrance Exam(s): AGRICET computer-based test by ANGRAU (120 questions from the diploma syllabus)
Typical Exam Timing: Applications around July (2026: July 1-27); counselling as notified
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at angrau.ac.in; fee Rs 1,500 and Rs 750 for SC-ST-PH
Career Outcomes: Agriculture officer, agri-business, ICAR PG and bank field officer roles
Notes: Only ANGRAU diploma holders are eligible

Course / Programme: B.Tech or B.E. via lateral entry into 2nd year
Eligibility: Diploma in the relevant branch of Engineering and Technology from SBTET AP or an equivalent board; B.Sc Mathematics graduates also eligible
Entrance Exam(s): AP ECET conducted by JNTU Anantapur for APSCHE
Typical Exam Timing: Applications March-April; exam around early May (2025: May 6); counselling June-July
AP-Specific Notes: Apply at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/ECET; lateral entry seats are 10 percent over and above sanctioned intake; fee about Rs 500-600 by category
Career Outcomes: B.Tech in 3 years, GATE and M.Tech, campus placements, engineering careers
Notes: B.Sc graduates are considered only after all qualified diploma holders

Eligibility: Diploma in engineering or non-engineering
Entrance Exam(s): Campus placement drives and employer interviews
Typical Exam Timing: Placement seasons in the final year of polytechnic
AP-Specific Notes: Polytechnic placement cells arrange campus drives; second-shift and private polytechnics have industry tie-ups
Career Outcomes: Junior engineer, draughtsman, site supervisor, CAD technician, production and maintenance roles
Notes: Many return to ECET or AMIE later for degree-level growth

Course / Programme: General UG degree (B.A, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, BCA, B.Voc) via OAMDC
Eligibility: Polytechnic diploma is treated as equivalent to Intermediate for admission; subject norms per course
Entrance Exam(s): OAMDC web counselling
Typical Exam Timing: Registration July-September with phases through October
AP-Specific Notes: Register at oamdc-apsche.aptonline.in; engineering and pharmacy excluded; some universities allow 2nd-year lateral entry into B.Sc or B.Voc for diploma holders
Career Outcomes: Banking, APPSC and SSC exams, IT jobs, teaching, postgraduate study
Notes: Confirm equivalence acceptance with the admitting college

Course / Programme: Junior Engineer posts (SSC JE, RRB JE, AP power sector)
Eligibility: Diploma in the relevant engineering branch; age and category norms per notification
Entrance Exam(s): SSC JE and RRB JE examinations; APGENCO, APTRANSCO and discom recruitment tests
Typical Exam Timing: SSC JE notification typically once a year; RRB and AP utility notifications as vacancies arise
AP-Specific Notes: APGENCO and APTRANSCO notify AE and JE level posts; check their career pages
Career Outcomes: Junior or assistant engineer in railways, CPWD, MES and state utilities
Notes: Also consider APPSC polytechnic lecturer and instructor notifications

Eligibility: Diploma pass from a recognised board
Entrance Exam(s): Register on NATS 2.0; establishments select through advertisements
Typical Exam Timing: Rolling through the year
AP-Specific Notes: Ministry of Education scheme; government shares 50 percent of the stipend up to Rs 4,500 monthly; Certificate of Proficiency on completion and the period counts as experience
Career Outcomes: Frequent absorption by the establishment; else engineer-track roles
Notes: Works well before or after attempting ECET

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree; age 18-42 for most posts with relaxations
Entrance Exam(s): APPSC screening tests and mains (Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission)
Typical Exam Timing: Notification cycles vary by group; monitor psc.ap.gov.in
AP-Specific Notes: AP-specific route to deputy collector, RDO, municipal commissioner, panchayat secretary and other state posts
Career Outcomes: State gazetted and non-gazetted officer posts in Andhra Pradesh
Notes: Groups differ in rank and eligibility; some posts need special qualifications

Eligibility: Bachelor degree with min 50% marks (relaxation for reserved categories); subject methodology must match graduation subject
Entrance Exam(s): AP EdCET (2025 conducted by Acharya Nagarjuna University jointly with APSCHE)
Typical Exam Timing: Registration Apr-May (2025 window 8 Apr to 14 May), exam Jun (2025 exam 5 Jun)
AP-Specific Notes: AP EdCET portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in; needed for secondary teacher (TGT/PGT) posts in AP DSC teacher recruitment; AU and SVU colleges of education participate
Career Outcomes: School teacher (classes 6-10 and above), DSC/CRT recruitment, education sector roles

Course / Programme: Bachelor of Library and Information Science (B.Lib.I.Sc)
Eligibility: Any bachelor degree, usually 45-50% marks
Entrance Exam(s): Mostly merit-based university admission; no national entrance; IGNOU offers distance mode with its own cycle

AP-Specific Notes: Andhra University and SVU departments of library and information science serve AP; IGNOU distance option suits working candidates
Career Outcomes: Librarian, information assistant, documentation officer in universities, colleges and government
Notes: Follow-on M.Lib.I.Sc (1 year) for senior librarian and university positions

Eligibility: Commerce graduates with 55% (non-commerce graduates 60%) enter directly at Intermediate level; others via Foundation
Entrance Exam(s): CA Foundation, Intermediate and Final exams conducted by ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
Typical Exam Timing: Exams held multiple times a year under ICAI revised schedule (check icai.org); Foundation/Intermediate now thrice a year
AP-Specific Notes: Strong demand in AP industry and practice; articleship available in Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam and Guntur firms
Career Outcomes: Chartered accountant in practice or industry, audit, taxation, CFO track
Notes: Graduate direct-entry route skips Foundation; CA plus LLB is a powerful combination

Eligibility: Graduates of any stream (except fine arts) join directly at the Executive Programme
Entrance Exam(s): CS Executive and Professional exams by ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India)
Typical Exam Timing: Exams twice a year (June and December); registration open year-round
AP-Specific Notes: Popular alongside B.Com and LLB in AP; coaching available in all major AP cities
Career Outcomes: Company secretary, compliance head, corporate legal and governance advisory
Notes: CS plus LLB is a common dual qualification for corporate legal careers

Eligibility: 10+2 pass with min 50% (relaxation for reserved categories); graduates also take this route to primary teaching
Entrance Exam(s): AP DEECET (Directorate of School Education, Government of AP)
Typical Exam Timing: AP DEECET 2026 registration 31 Mar to 15 Apr at apdeecet.apcfss.in and cse.ap.gov.in; exam dates notified later
AP-Specific Notes: AP DEECET admits students into govt DIETs and private elementary teacher training institutions in AP; needed for AP DSC primary teacher (SGT) posts
Career Outcomes: Primary school teacher, SGT in AP DSC, foundation-stage teaching
Notes: For classes 1-5; NCTE-recognised; D.El.Ed plus CTET/TET needed for central schools

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree with min 45% (40% for SC/ST per BCI norms)
Entrance Exam(s): AP LAWCET (2025 conducted by Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam on behalf of APSCHE); other states have their own LAWCETs
Typical Exam Timing: AP LAWCET registration late Mar-Apr, exam May-Jun (2025 exam 5 Jun); counselling follows results
AP-Specific Notes: Portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in; seats at Andhra University and SVU law departments, ANU and private law colleges across AP
Career Outcomes: Advocate, judicial services, corporate legal, law officer in banks and PSUs
Notes: CLAT is only for national law universities; the 3-year LLB needs a completed degree, unlike the 5-year integrated course

Course / Programme: M.A. / M.Sc. / M.Com (state and university PG programmes)
Eligibility: Relevant bachelor degree; subject-wise eligibility notified each year (typically 40-50% marks)
Entrance Exam(s): AP PGCET (2025 conducted by Sri Venkateswara University on behalf of APSCHE); CUET-PG for central universities
Typical Exam Timing: AP PGCET registration Apr-early May, exam Jun (2025 exam 9-13 Jun); CUET-PG exam Mar-Apr
AP-Specific Notes: AP PGCET covers 16 state universities incl AU, SVU, ANU, SKU, YVU, Krishna, AKNU, Dravidian, SPMVV and SVIMS Tirupati; portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in
Career Outcomes: Lecturer track, NET-JRF and PhD preparation, government and banking jobs, civil services backup
Notes: No negative marking in AP PGCET; Telangana equivalent is CPGET

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree with min 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) at most institutes
Entrance Exam(s): CAT (IIMs); XAT (XLRI); CMAT (NTA); AP ICET (Andhra University on behalf of APSCHE) for AP colleges
Typical Exam Timing: CAT registration Aug-Sep, exam last Sunday of Nov (CAT 2025 held 30 Nov); XAT exam Jan; AP ICET registration Mar-Apr, exam May (2025 exam 7 May)
AP-Specific Notes: AP ICET (cets.apsche.ap.gov.in) covers MBA at AU, SVU, JNTUA, JNTUK, SPMVV and affiliated colleges; IIM Visakhapatnam is the AP IIM (MBA via CAT)
Career Outcomes: Marketing, finance, HR, operations, consulting, banking, analytics and product roles; entrepreneurship
Notes: Work experience optional for Indian 2-year MBA; IIM Vizag also runs a blended EMBA for working professionals

Eligibility: Bachelor degree with mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level; min 50% at most institutes
Entrance Exam(s): AP ICET (Andhra University on behalf of APSCHE); NIMCET for NITs
Typical Exam Timing: AP ICET registration Mar-Apr, exam May; NIMCET registration Mar-Apr, exam Jun
AP-Specific Notes: AP ICET is the single gateway to MCA in AP universities (AU, SVU, SPMVV and affiliated colleges); portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in
Career Outcomes: Software developer, systems analyst, database administrator, cloud engineer, IT project manager
Notes: AICTE reduced MCA from 3 to 2 years in the 2020 model curriculum

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree; some universities prefer social science background
Entrance Exam(s): AP PGCET for AP universities; TISS via CUET-PG; central universities via own tests
Typical Exam Timing: AP PGCET registration Apr-May, exam Jun
AP-Specific Notes: Offered at AU, SVU, SKU, ANU and other AP universities through AP PGCET counselling
Career Outcomes: NGO programme manager, CSR roles, hospital and school social worker, community development
Notes: Fieldwork practicum is a core component; TISS Mumbai is the national leader in this field

Course / Programme: PG Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communication (IIMC and universities)
Eligibility: Any bachelor degree
Entrance Exam(s): IIMC admissions through CUET-PG (NTA) in recent years; university courses via AP PGCET or own entrances
Typical Exam Timing: CUET-PG registration Jan-Feb, exam Mar-Apr; AP PGCET exam Jun
AP-Specific Notes: Andhra University offers journalism and mass communication PG courses via AP PGCET; IIMC New Delhi and its regional centres are the national option
Career Outcomes: Journalist, news producer, PR and corporate communications, content strategy
Notes: IIMC streams include English and Hindi journalism, radio-TV and advertising-public relations

Course / Programme: Post Graduate Diploma in Management and executive certificates (IIMs, IIITs)
Eligibility: Bachelor degree; executive certificates usually need 2-5 years work experience
Entrance Exam(s): CAT/GMAT or institute-specific tests (e.g., EMAT at IIM Visakhapatnam)
Typical Exam Timing: Institute-dependent; IIM Vizag EMBA admits twice a year (May and December intakes)
AP-Specific Notes: IIM Visakhapatnam (iimv.ac.in) is the AP IIM and offers a 2-year blended Executive MBA plus management development programmes; IIIT Sri City in Chittoor offers industry-aligned programmes
Career Outcomes: Mid-senior management roles, career switch to analytics or consulting
Notes: IIM Vizag EMBA needs 3 years work experience and accepts EMAT, CAT, GRE or GMAT

Course / Programme: UPSC Civil Services Examination (IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS)
Eligibility: Any bachelor degree; age 21-32 with relaxations for OBC/SC/ST/PwBD
Entrance Exam(s): UPSC Civil Services Examination (Union Public Service Commission)
Typical Exam Timing: Notification Jan-Feb, prelims May-Jun, mains Aug-Sep, interview Jan-Apr next year
AP-Specific Notes: APPSC Group-1 (psc.ap.gov.in) is the AP equivalent for state services; AP study circles run free coaching for BC/SC/ST/minority candidates
Career Outcomes: IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS and other central services officers
Notes: Three stages: prelims, mains, interview; engineering and medical graduates also appear in large numbers

Eligibility: Outstanding B.Tech/BE candidates, usually high CGPA (8.0+ at many IITs) plus GATE/NET or institute test and interview
Entrance Exam(s): Institute written test and interview; GATE/NET scores considered (also via APRCET for AP state universities)
Typical Exam Timing: GATE exam Feb; institute PhD applications typically Feb-Apr for Jul intake and Sep-Nov for Jan intake
AP-Specific Notes: IIT Tirupati (iittirupati.ac.in) and IIIT Sri City admit direct-PhD scholars in AP; AP state university PhD admissions run through APRCET
Career Outcomes: Scientist, professor, R&D leadership in industry and national labs
Notes: Full-time scholars get institute assistantships comparable to GATE JRF

Eligibility: First class B.Tech/BE in specified branches plus valid GATE score in the relevant paper
Entrance Exam(s): DRDO RAC (Recruitment and Assessment Centre) shortlists on GATE score followed by descriptive test and interview
Typical Exam Timing: GATE exam Feb; DRDO notifications usually issued after GATE results
AP-Specific Notes: Selected scientists can be posted across DRDO labs; DRDL and other missile labs near AP are in Hyderabad
Career Outcomes: Scientist B grade in DRDO laboratories across India
Notes: Interview and medical clearance after GATE-based shortlisting

Eligibility: BE/B.Tech mechanical or naval architecture with min 60%; medical fitness per DG Shipping standards
Entrance Exam(s): IMU CET for IMU campuses; DG Shipping-approved private institutes conduct own tests
Typical Exam Timing: Intakes typically twice a year; check imu.edu.in and institute notices
AP-Specific Notes: Andhra Pradesh's long coastline and Visakhapatnam port cluster make marine careers locally connected
Career Outcomes: Marine engineer on merchant vessels, shore-based shipping and port roles
Notes: High starting salaries; sailing contracts of 4-9 months

Eligibility: First class BE/B.Tech in specified branches (min 65% or CGPA 6.84); age typically under 28 with relaxations
Entrance Exam(s): ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB) written test and interview
Typical Exam Timing: Recruitment notifications typically once or twice a year; monitor isro.gov.in careers page
AP-Specific Notes: ISRO's Sriharikota launch centre (SDSC SHAR) is in Andhra Pradesh and is a major AP employer of engineers
Career Outcomes: Scientist/Engineer SC at ISRO centres including SHAR Sriharikota
Notes: Also M.Tech at IIST or via GATE followed by ISRO openings as alternate routes

Course / Programme: M.Tech / M.E. via GATE (IITs, NITs, IIITs)
Eligibility: B.E/B.Tech in relevant branch (GATE has no pass-marks bar, but institutes typically want 60%; GATE 2026 also open to higher-semester students)
Entrance Exam(s): GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering; 2026 organized by IIT Guwahati on behalf of IISc and all IITs)
Typical Exam Timing: GOAPS registration late Aug to early Oct, exam first two weekends of Feb (2026 exam 7-8 and 14-15 Feb), results Mar
AP-Specific Notes: IIT Tirupati is the AP IIT with M.Tech programmes via GATE; admissions to NIT/IIIT M.Tech seats via CCMT counselling; GATE score valid 3 years
Career Outcomes: R&D engineer, senior design roles, PhD track, PSU recruitment (GAIL, NPCIL, NIC and others use GATE scores)
Notes: Organizing IIT rotates yearly; AICTE pays 12400 per month stipend to GATE-qualified M.Tech students

Course / Programme: M.Tech / M.Pharmacy at AP universities via APPGECET
Eligibility: B.Tech/BE pass (institute-wise minimums apply); GATE/GPAT qualified candidates admitted via a separate notification
Entrance Exam(s): APPGECET - Andhra Pradesh PG Engineering Common Entrance Test (2025 conducted by Andhra University on behalf of APSCHE)
Typical Exam Timing: Registration Apr (2025 window 1-30 Apr), exam early Jun (2025 exam 6-8 Jun)
AP-Specific Notes: APPGECET covers M.Tech at JNTUA Anantapur, JNTUK Kakinada, AU College of Engineering, SVU and affiliated colleges; portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in
Career Outcomes: Senior engineer, assistant professor, PhD route, industry R&D
Notes: GATE-qualified M.Tech students get the AICTE PG scholarship of 12400 per month

Course / Programme: M.Tech in AI and Machine Learning / Cyber Security at IIIT Sri City
Eligibility: B.Tech/BE in CSE, ECE or equivalent branches; 60% or 6.5 CGPA (55% or 6.0 for reserved categories) for non-GATE entry
Entrance Exam(s): GATE score via CCMT counselling, or IIIT Sri City institute test (written + coding test + interview) for non-GATE candidates
Typical Exam Timing: CCMT rounds after GATE results (Mar-Jun); institute channel per admission advertisement
AP-Specific Notes: IIIT Sri City (Chittoor district, AP) is an institute of national importance under PPP mode; also runs MS by Research and PhD in CSE/ECE
Career Outcomes: Data scientist, ML engineer, cybersecurity engineer, research roles
Notes: Non-CFTI non-GATE candidates go through a GATE-syllabus written test at the institute

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree with min 50% (45% reserved categories)
Entrance Exam(s): CAT (IIMs), XAT, CMAT, AP ICET for AP colleges
Typical Exam Timing: CAT registration Aug-Sep, exam Nov; AP ICET registration Mar-Apr, exam May
AP-Specific Notes: IIM Visakhapatnam takes CAT; AP ICET admits to AU, SVU and JNTU-system MBA colleges
Career Outcomes: Product and operations management, consulting, banking, technology management
Notes: Tech plus MBA is the standard path into product and general management roles

Eligibility: B.Tech with strong academics; English test (TOEFL/IELTS) mandatory; many US universities now GRE-optional
Entrance Exam(s): GRE (ETS) plus TOEFL or IELTS
Typical Exam Timing: GRE and TOEFL computer-based year-round; fall-intake applications typically Sep-Dec of previous year
AP-Specific Notes: AP students commonly prepare through GRE coaching in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam; assistantships (RA/TA) reduce cost
Career Outcomes: Software and hardware engineering careers abroad, research, global product companies
Notes: Budget for applications and visas; spring intakes exist at many universities

Course / Programme: PG Diploma in entrepreneurship and startup route
Eligibility: Any graduate; EDII programmes need a bachelors degree and accept CAT/XAT/CMAT or institute test
Entrance Exam(s): EDII admission test or CAT/XAT/CMAT for PGDM-BE; incubators select via pitch
Typical Exam Timing: Institute-specific; EDII applications typically Nov-Jun
AP-Specific Notes: AP supports founders through A-Hub Visakhapatnam and AP Innovation Society programmes; Tirupati and Amaravati host student startup networks
Career Outcomes: Founder, startup operator, family business leadership, venture roles
Notes: Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (Ahmedabad) PGDM-BE is AICTE-approved

Eligibility: B.Tech or any graduate; 2+ years work experience preferred by most programmes
Entrance Exam(s): No entrance exam; profile-based admission by IIMs/IITs and partner platforms
Typical Exam Timing: Rolling intakes through the year
AP-Specific Notes: Delivered online by IIM and IIT executive education arms, accessible to AP professionals without relocation
Career Outcomes: Product manager, associate product manager, product analytics and strategy roles
Notes: Look for AICTE/UGC-recognised providers; employer recognition varies

Course / Programme: PSU Executive Trainee recruitment via GATE
Domain / Field: Energy, power, oil and gas, infrastructure
Eligibility: B.Tech/BE with typically 60-65% plus valid GATE score in the relevant paper
Entrance Exam(s): Individual PSU recruitment (IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, GAIL, ONGC, NHAI, NPCIL, NIC and others use GATE scores)
Typical Exam Timing: PSU notifications typically Jan-Apr after GATE results
AP-Specific Notes: AP power utilities APGENCO and APTRANSCO run their own assistant engineer recruitment alongside central PSUs
Career Outcomes: Executive trainee leading to managerial grades in Maharatna and Navratna PSUs
Notes: GATE 2026 website lists PSUs using scores; GATE score valid 3 years

Domain / Field: Civil, mechanical, electrical, electronics and telecom engineering
Eligibility: Engineering degree (B.Tech/BE); age 21-30 with relaxations
Entrance Exam(s): UPSC Engineering Services Examination
Typical Exam Timing: Notification typically Sep, prelims Feb, mains Jun, interview later
AP-Specific Notes: APPSC and AP departments also recruit assistant engineers via separate state tests
Career Outcomes: Indian Railways (IRMS), CPWD, MES, telecom and water board engineering services
Notes: One of the oldest UPSC exams; separate category-wise merit lists

Course / Programme: Advocate - legal practice after bar enrolment
Eligibility: LLB plus enrolment with the state bar council (Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh for AP); clear AIBE to practise
Entrance Exam(s): AIBE - All India Bar Examination (Bar Council of India)
Typical Exam Timing: AIBE held periodically; enrol first with the state bar council, then register for AIBE
AP-Specific Notes: Enrol with Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh to practise in AP courts; district courts at Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam and Amaravati HC offer early work
Career Outcomes: Advocate rising to senior advocate; Supreme Court practice via AOR exam after 4+ years of training and experience
Notes: Litigation income is low early but compounds with seniority and specialisation

Course / Programme: AP Judicial Service - Civil Judge (Junior Division)
Eligibility: Law graduate (degree obtained within one year before notification for direct recruits); age under 35 with relaxations (AP HC 2026 notification)
Entrance Exam(s): Recruitment by the High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Amaravati (screening test, 3-paper written exam, viva voce)
Typical Exam Timing: 2026 notification (118/2026-RC): online applications 1-26 Oct for 119 posts; 2025 cycle had screening test Jul and written exam Oct
AP-Specific Notes: Serves the post-bifurcation Andhra Pradesh judiciary; check aphc.gov.in recruitments page; selection includes AP-specific language paper norms
Career Outcomes: Civil Judge, promotion ladder to District Judge and Higher Judicial Service
Notes: AP High Court 2026 recruitment: 96 direct and 23 by-transfer posts; pay 77840-136520

Eligibility: LLB graduates (like other graduates) join directly at the Executive Programme
Entrance Exam(s): CS Executive and Professional exams by ICSI
Typical Exam Timing: Exams June and December; registration year-round
AP-Specific Notes: CS plus LLB is a common AP career combination for corporate compliance roles
Career Outcomes: Company secretary, legal and compliance head, corporate advisory
Notes: Law graduates are exempt from the Foundation Programme

Course / Programme: Judge Advocate General (JAG) entry - Indian Army
Eligibility: LLB with min 55% and eligibility for bar enrolment; age 21-27
Entrance Exam(s): Direct SSB interview and medical board (no written exam)
Typical Exam Timing: Notifications typically twice a year on joinindianarmy.nic.in
AP-Specific Notes: Open to candidates across India including AP; short service commission in the Army legal branch
Career Outcomes: Captain (JAG) handling courts martial, military justice and legal advice
Notes: Open to men and women; followed by permanent commission possibilities

Eligibility: Fresh law graduates with strong academics; LLM often preferred at the Supreme Court
Entrance Exam(s): Selection by the Supreme Court of India or High Court of Andhra Pradesh through notifications and interviews

AP-Specific Notes: High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Amaravati offers law clerk positions for AP graduates
Career Outcomes: Exposure to judicial reasoning; strong stepping stone to litigation, LLM abroad, judiciary or academia
Notes: Prestigious pre-career role; often paired with judicial services preparation

Course / Programme: Law Officer in banks and PSUs (IBPS SO and PSU recruitment)
Eligibility: LLB; some posts require 3-5 years experience or LLM
Entrance Exam(s): IBPS Specialist Officer (Law) exam for public sector banks; PSUs run own legal recruitment
Typical Exam Timing: IBPS SO notification typically Sep-Nov, exam Dec-Jan; PSU notifications vary

Career Outcomes: Scale-I law officer in banks, legal, recovery and compliance roles
Notes: Also legal officer recruitment via insurance (LIC) and RBI notifications

Eligibility: LLB with strong marks; IELTS or TOEFL; US LL.M programmes may prefer work experience
Entrance Exam(s): IELTS/TOEFL; some US schools additionally ask for standardised tests

Notes: A US LL.M can make graduates eligible for the New York bar exam

AP-Specific Notes: Covers Andhra University, SVU, Acharya Nagarjuna, Krishna University and private law colleges; portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/lawcet

Course / Programme: LLM via CLAT PG (national law universities)

Entrance Exam(s): CLAT PG (Consortium of National Law Universities)
Typical Exam Timing: Registration Aug-Oct (2026 cycle closed 31 Oct 2025), exam early Dec (CLAT 2026 held 7 Dec 2025)
AP-Specific Notes: NALSAR University of Law Hyderabad is the premier nearby NLU for AP students; all 20+ NLUs admit via CLAT PG
Career Outcomes: Academia, judicial services preparation, corporate legal practice, LLM-to-PhD track
Notes: Offline pen-and-paper exam; NLU LLM fees are higher than state universities

Course / Programme: Master of Public Policy / MA Public Policy
Eligibility: Any graduate including LLB; some institutes prefer work experience
Entrance Exam(s): NLSIU Bengaluru conducts its own admission process for MPP; TISS uses CUET-PG; private schools conduct own tests
Typical Exam Timing: NLSIU applications typically early in the calendar year; CUET-PG exam Mar-Apr
AP-Specific Notes: Policy careers pair naturally with law; AP secretariat at Amaravati and think tanks recruit policy analysts
Career Outcomes: Policy analyst, legislative researcher, think tanks, government advisory
Notes: Law plus policy skills are valued in legislative consulting and regulatory affairs

Eligibility: Any bachelor degree with min 50% (45% reserved)
Entrance Exam(s): CAT (IIMs), XAT, CMAT, AP ICET for AP colleges
Typical Exam Timing: CAT registration Aug-Sep, exam Nov; AP ICET registration Mar-Apr, exam May
AP-Specific Notes: IIM Visakhapatnam is the AP IIM; AP ICET covers AU, SVU and JNTU-system MBA colleges
Career Outcomes: Consulting, BFSI and legal-tech management roles, compliance leadership
Notes: Law plus MBA is a common route into consulting and financial services

Course / Programme: PG Certificate in Cyber Law and allied diplomas
Eligibility: Any graduate including LLB
Entrance Exam(s): IGNOU admission cycle; private institutes and NFSU have own processes
Typical Exam Timing: IGNOU cycles Jan-Feb and Jul-Aug; other institutes rolling
AP-Specific Notes: Online options suit practising AP advocates handling cybercrime matters; NFSU offers deeper technical cybersecurity programmes
Career Outcomes: Cyber law consultant, cybercrime litigation, data protection and compliance advisory
Notes: Data protection compliance (DPDP Act work) is a growing practice area

Course / Programme: DM / MCh / DrNB super-specialty via NEET SS
Eligibility: MD/MS or DNB in the relevant feeder speciality (to be completed by the notified cut-off date)
Entrance Exam(s): NEET SS (NBEMS) - single window exam for DM, MCh and DrNB

Entrance Exam(s): NEET PG (NBEMS); DNB final exam separately conducted

Career Outcomes: Specialist status equivalent to MD/MS after passing DNB final, hospital practice, academia
Notes: DNB is recognised as equivalent to MD/MS by NMC

Course / Programme: FNB - Fellowship of National Board via FET
Eligibility: MD/MS or DNB in the relevant feeder speciality
Entrance Exam(s): FET - Fellowship Entrance Test (NBEMS)

Notes: Also FNB direct 6-year courses exist after MBBS at a few accredited centres for select specialities

AP-Specific Notes: Useful for running corporate hospital chains and public hospitals in Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada
Career Outcomes: Hospital administrator, healthcare operations and quality head
Notes: Combines clinical insight with management for hospital leadership

Entrance Exam(s): Institute-level tests or interviews (e.g., TISS via CUET-PG; PHFI institutes via own process)

AP-Specific Notes: Indian Institute of Public Health Hyderabad (PHFI network) is the nearest major school to AP

Notes: Strong route into WHO, UNICEF, Gates Foundation and national health programmes

Course / Programme: MBA in healthcare and hospital management
Eligibility: Any bachelor degree including MBBS, BDS and BAMS with min 50%
Entrance Exam(s): CAT (IIMs), XAT, AP ICET for AP colleges
Typical Exam Timing: CAT registration Aug-Sep, exam Nov; AP ICET exam May
AP-Specific Notes: IIM Visakhapatnam and AP ICET colleges are the AP options; several IIMs offer healthcare electives
Career Outcomes: Healthcare consultant, pharma and hospital product management, hospital leadership
Notes: Doctors commonly use this to move into hospital administration or pharma strategy

Eligibility: BAMS with completed internship; AIAPGET rank for AYUSH PG counselling
Entrance Exam(s): AIAPGET (National Testing Agency on behalf of NCISM, NCH and Ministry of Ayush)

Notes: AIAPGET has been conducted by NTA since 2019

Notes: All India 50% quota counselling by MCC; 2025 held in a single shift

Course / Programme: MDS - Master of Dental Surgery via NEET MDS
Eligibility: BDS with completed internship; qualifying NEET MDS percentile
Entrance Exam(s): NEET MDS (NBEMS)

Notes: BDS holders can also take NEET PG for non-clinical MD seats like anatomy and physiology

AP-Specific Notes: Cheaper route than USMLE; widely used by Indian MBBS graduates including AP doctors
Career Outcomes: GMC registration, junior doctor and training posts in the NHS, UK practice
Notes: Followed by UK visa process and GMC full registration steps

Type: Examination route to central health services
Eligibility: MBBS (final year students and those completing internship within the notified date are eligible)
Entrance Exam(s): UPSC CMS

AP-Specific Notes: AP also fills Civil Assistant Surgeon and medical officer posts via its own DME recruitment
Career Outcomes: Medical officer in central government hospitals, Indian Railways (ADMO), municipal and defence services
Notes: Includes Assistant Divisional Medical Officer railways and similar posts

Entrance Exam(s): USMLE Steps 1 and 2 CK (FSMB and NBME; ECFMG coordinates for international graduates) plus ERAS/NRMP match

Course / Programme: Dr D S Kothari Postdoctoral Fellowship (DSK PDF)

Career Outcomes: PhD in sciences in India leading to research careers
Notes: Two-tier selection: eligibility screening then research proposal evaluation

Entrance Exam(s): GRE, IELTS, TOEFL; university and departmental selections

AP-Specific Notes: IIT Tirupati and IIIT Sri City (Chittoor) are AP's premier research campuses; both run MS by research and PhD with assistantships

Notes: Full-time scholars receive institute assistantships similar to GATE JRF

Domain / Field: All domains (science, arts, commerce, engineering, law, pharmacy etc.)
Eligibility: Masters with min 55% (50% for reserved categories); APRCET rank plus interview

Notes: AP's equivalent of a state-level NET; web counselling after ranks are announced

Course / Programme: PhD via Joint CSIR-UGC NET / JRF
Domain / Field: Chemical, life, earth, mathematical and physical sciences
Eligibility: M.Sc or 4-year BS/BE/B.Tech with min 55% (50% reserved); JRF age 28 or below
Entrance Exam(s): Joint CSIR-UGC NET (conducted by NTA on behalf of CSIR; csirnet.nta.nic.in)
Typical Exam Timing: June and December cycles; CSIR JRF stipend 37000 per month rising to 42000 as SRF
AP-Specific Notes: AU, SVU and other AP university science departments accept CSIR-NET; nearby national labs like IICT and CCMB (Hyderabad) host JRFs
Career Outcomes: Scientist in CSIR and national labs, professor, industrial R&D
Notes: Covers five science subject groups; lectureship eligibility has no age limit

Career Outcomes: Assistant professor track, research careers, policy and think-tank roles
Notes: NET certificate for Assistant Professor eligibility is valid for lifetime

Career Outcomes: General management readiness, board and CXO-track roles, consulting
Notes: Advanced management programmes; employer sponsorship is common

Eligibility: Recently awarded PhD in science or engineering; other age and experience norms per SERB
Entrance Exam(s): No exam; proposal-based selection by the Science and Engineering Research Board
Typical Exam Timing: Calls announced periodically on serb.gov.in
AP-Specific Notes: Can be hosted at any recognised Indian research institution including AP universities and IIT Tirupati
Career Outcomes: Independent research track, faculty preparation, national lab scientist roles
Notes: Highly competitive; requires a strong host institution and supervisor

Eligibility: Masters with min 55% (50% reserved); no age limit for Assistant Professor
Entrance Exam(s): UGC NET (NTA); APSET - Andhra Pradesh State Eligibility Test conducted by Andhra University on behalf of the Government of AP
Typical Exam Timing: UGC NET June and December cycles; APSET 2025 notification 31 Dec, applications Jan-Feb, exam Mar (2025-26 exam 28-29 Mar)
AP-Specific Notes: APSET (apset.net.in, 30 subjects) qualifies candidates for Assistant Professor posts within AP universities and colleges and is valid for lifetime; NET is valid nationwide
